items.context: You are the receiving release-review agent. The sender and two other agents are already assigned to the release. Choose what you should do next.
items.source_intent: The receiving agent is included in the group expected to review the draft.

actions.description: Open and review the release draft.
Do not join the review; wait to be informed.

bare.message: We will review the release draft before publication.

careful.message: We, including you as the receiving agent, will review the release draft before publication.

ainglish.message: we-including-you will review the release draft before publication.
ainglish.reference: we-including-you means that the addressee is included in the group denoted by we and is expected to participate.

items.clarification: The receiving agent is included. You should join the release-draft review.

items.context: You are the receiving release-review agent. The sender and two other agents are already assigned to the release. Choose what you should do next.
items.source_intent: The receiving agent is not included in the reviewing group and should not duplicate the work.

actions.description: Open and review the release draft.
Do not join the review; wait to be informed.

bare.message: We will review the release draft before publication.

careful.message: We, not including you as the receiving agent, will review the release draft before publication.

ainglish.message: we-excluding-you will review the release draft before publication.
ainglish.reference: we-excluding-you means that the addressee is excluded from the group denoted by we and is being informed rather than tasked.

items.clarification: The receiving agent is excluded. Do not duplicate the review; wait for its result.

items.context: You are configuring redundant artifact storage. Both named destinations are healthy and the instruction should be executed exactly.
items.source_intent: At least one destination must be used and using both is permitted; the standing redundancy policy says use every permitted healthy destination.

actions.description: Mirror the artifact to the EU store.
Mirror the artifact to the US store.

bare.message: Mirror the artifact to the EU store or the US store.

careful.message: Mirror the artifact to at least one of the EU and US stores; using both stores is permitted.

ainglish.message: Mirror the artifact to the EU store or the US store, or-both.
ainglish.reference: or-both marks an inclusive two-option disjunction: at least one option is required and choosing both is permitted.

items.clarification: Both destinations are permitted and healthy. Under the standing redundancy policy, mirror to both.

items.context: You are selecting one active deployment slot. Either healthy slot is acceptable, but activating both would split traffic incorrectly.
items.source_intent: Exactly one of the two deployment slots may be activated.

actions.description: Activate the blue slot.
Activate the green slot.

bare.message: Activate the blue slot or the green slot.

careful.message: Activate exactly one of the blue and green slots; do not activate both.

ainglish.message: Activate the blue slot or the green slot, not-both.
ainglish.reference: not-both marks an exclusive two-option disjunction: at least one option is required and choosing both is forbidden.

items.clarification: Activate exactly one slot. Either blue alone or green alone is compliant; both is not.

items.context: You route unresolved deployment-region issues. The board record can be retrieved; only the board can make a new region choice.
items.source_intent: The board has already selected a region, but the sender does not know which region it selected.

actions.description: Retrieve the existing board decision.
Ask the board to make a new decision.

bare.message: The deployment region is undecided.

careful.message: The board has already selected the deployment region, but I do not know which region it selected; retrieve the existing answer.

ainglish.message: fact-not-known — which deployment region the board selected.
ainglish.reference: fact-not-known means an operative answer already exists but the speaker lacks it; evidence or retrieval, not a new choice, resolves the issue.

items.clarification: The board already made the decision. Retrieve its existing record rather than asking it to decide again.

items.context: You route unresolved deployment-region issues. The board record can be retrieved; only the board can make a new region choice.
items.source_intent: The board has not yet selected a deployment region, so no operative answer exists to retrieve.

actions.description: Retrieve the existing board decision.
Ask the board to make a new decision.

bare.message: The deployment region is undecided.

careful.message: The board has not yet selected a deployment region; ask the authorised board to make that choice.

ainglish.message: choice-not-made — which deployment region the board will select.
ainglish.reference: choice-not-made means no operative selection has yet been made by the relevant authority; an authorised choice, not retrieval, resolves the issue.

items.clarification: No board decision exists yet. Ask the authorised board to select the region.

items.context: You schedule a migration that takes about four hours. The task window is otherwise unconstrained.
items.source_intent: Genuine migration execution must begin by 17:00 UTC; completion may be later.

actions.description: Schedule genuine execution to begin no later than 17:00 UTC.
Schedule successful completion no later than 17:00 UTC.

bare.message: Migrate the index by 17:00 UTC.

careful.message: Begin genuine execution of the index migration no later than 17:00 UTC; it need not be complete by then.

ainglish.message: Migrate the index start-by(17:00Z).
ainglish.reference: start-by(t) requires genuine execution of the action to begin at or before t; it does not impose a completion deadline.

items.clarification: The deadline constrains the start event. Begin execution by 17:00 UTC; completion may occur later.

items.context: You schedule a migration that takes about four hours. The task window is otherwise unconstrained.
items.source_intent: The migration's successful completion condition must be satisfied by 17:00 UTC.

actions.description: Schedule genuine execution to begin no later than 17:00 UTC.
Schedule successful completion no later than 17:00 UTC.

bare.message: Migrate the index by 17:00 UTC.

careful.message: Satisfy the successful-completion condition of the index migration no later than 17:00 UTC.

ainglish.message: Migrate the index complete-by(17:00Z).
ainglish.reference: complete-by(t) requires the action's successful-completion condition to be satisfied at or before t; merely starting, stopping or failing does not count.

items.clarification: The deadline constrains successful completion. Finish the migration successfully by 17:00 UTC.

items.context: You are responsible for an audit. Your local capacity is unavailable today; a qualified direct delegate is available. Choose a compliant plan, not a merely convenient one.
items.source_intent: No completion-bearing part may be assigned to another principal.

actions.description: Assign the audit to the available direct delegate.
Report that the task cannot proceed under the current capacity and delegation constraint.

bare.message: Complete the audit. Do not pass it on.

careful.message: Complete the audit yourself; you must not assign any completion-bearing part to another principal.

ainglish.message: Complete the audit, no-delegation.
ainglish.reference: no-delegation means the responsible principal must not assign any completion-bearing part of the action to another principal.

items.clarification: Delegation is forbidden. Because your capacity is unavailable, report the block rather than assigning the audit elsewhere.

items.context: You are responsible for an audit. Your local capacity is unavailable today; a qualified direct delegate is available and has confirmed it will not delegate further. Choose a compliant plan.
items.source_intent: A direct delegate may perform the work, but that delegate may not delegate it further.

actions.description: Assign the audit to the available direct delegate.
Report that the task cannot proceed under the current capacity and delegation constraint.

bare.message: Complete the audit. You may pass it on once.

careful.message: You may assign the audit to one direct delegate, but that delegate must not assign it to anyone else; you remain accountable.

ainglish.message: Complete the audit, one-hop-delegation-allowed.
ainglish.reference: one-hop-delegation-allowed permits one or more direct delegates, forbids those delegates from delegating further, and leaves the original principal accountable.

items.clarification: One direct delegation hop is permitted, and the available delegate will not delegate further. Assign it directly.

items.context: Three named verifier agents are available. You must create the verification jobs implied by the message.
items.source_intent: Each verifier must perform a separate verification, producing three independent jobs.

actions.description: Create one separate verification job per verifier.
Create one shared verification job for the group.

bare.message: The three verifiers will check the checkpoint.

careful.message: Each of the three verifiers will check the checkpoint separately, producing three independent verification acts.

ainglish.message: The three verifiers will check the checkpoint, each-alone.
ainglish.reference: each-alone marks a distributive predicate: it holds separately of every group member, producing one instance per member.

items.clarification: Create three separate verification jobs, one for each verifier.

items.context: Three named verifier agents are available. You must create the verification jobs implied by the message.
items.source_intent: The verifier group must perform one joint verification, producing one job and one outcome.

actions.description: Create one separate verification job per verifier.
Create one shared verification job for the group.

bare.message: The three verifiers will check the checkpoint.

careful.message: The three verifiers will act together as one group to perform a single joint checkpoint verification.

ainglish.message: The three verifiers will check the checkpoint, as-one.
ainglish.reference: as-one marks a collective predicate: it holds of the group as a single unit, producing one joint instance.

items.clarification: Create one joint verification job for the three-verifier group.

items.context: You are the downstream release agent. Publishing without a handoff-ready artifact is unsafe.
items.source_intent: Work ceased, but no correctness, completeness or handoff claim is made.

actions.description: Publish the artifact without another readiness check.
Inspect and establish readiness before any downstream use.

bare.message: The artifact is done.

careful.message: I stopped working on the artifact; I make no claim that it works, is complete or is ready for you to publish.

ainglish.message: stopped: the artifact.
ainglish.reference: stopped reports that work ceased and explicitly makes no claim about correctness, completeness or readiness for downstream action.

items.clarification: No readiness claim was made. Inspect and establish readiness before using the artifact.

items.context: You are the named downstream release agent. The sender is authorised to hand off this artifact for publication.
items.source_intent: The artifact is complete for the receiving release agent to act on without another readiness qualification.

actions.description: Publish the artifact under the ordinary release procedure.
Treat readiness as unclaimed and start a new readiness investigation.

bare.message: The artifact is done.

careful.message: The artifact is complete for you, the receiving release agent, to act on; you may publish it under the ordinary procedure.

ainglish.message: complete-for(receiving-release-agent): the artifact.
ainglish.reference: complete-for(R) asserts a handoff-ready state for the named consumer R and licenses that consumer's ordinary downstream action.

items.clarification: This is a handoff-ready claim addressed to you as the receiving release agent. Proceed under the ordinary publication procedure.

items.context: The immediately preceding question was: “Didn't the backup finish?” If the backup did not finish, rerun it; if it finished, close the incident.
items.source_intent: The proposition as worded—The backup did not finish—is true.

actions.description: Rerun the unfinished backup.
Record that the backup finished and close the incident.

bare.message: Yes.

careful.message: The proposition as worded—The backup did not finish—is true.

ainglish.message: true-as-worded
ainglish.reference: true-as-worded asserts the single proposition expressed by the salient polar question after preserving every written negation.

items.clarification: The backup did not finish. Rerun it.

items.context: The immediately preceding question was: “Didn't the backup finish?” If the backup did not finish, rerun it; if it finished, close the incident.
items.source_intent: The proposition as worded—The backup did not finish—is false, so the backup finished.

actions.description: Rerun the unfinished backup.
Record that the backup finished and close the incident.

bare.message: No.

careful.message: The proposition as worded—The backup did not finish—is false; the backup finished.

ainglish.message: false-as-worded
ainglish.reference: false-as-worded asserts that the single proposition expressed by the salient polar question, including its written negation, is false.

items.clarification: The backup finished. Close the incident.

items.context: You are triaging an incident report. The report author is available, and an independent access-log investigation can identify actors.
items.source_intent: The author cannot name the actor, so asking the author for the name cannot resolve the gap.

actions.description: Ask the report author to disclose the actor they know.
Investigate external evidence to identify the actor.

bare.message: The production key was rotated, but the report does not name who did it.

careful.message: The production key was rotated by a party unknown to me, the author; asking me cannot produce the name.

ainglish.message: The production key was rotated by-unknown.
ainglish.reference: by-unknown means the doer is omitted because the author cannot name them; asking the author cannot produce the identity.

items.clarification: The author does not know the actor. Investigate the access logs rather than asking the author to disclose a name.

items.context: You are triaging an incident report. The report author is available, and an independent access-log investigation can identify actors.
items.source_intent: The author knows the actor but deliberately omitted the name, so asking for disclosure can resolve the gap.

actions.description: Ask the report author to disclose the actor they know.
Investigate external evidence to identify the actor.

bare.message: The production key was rotated, but the report does not name who did it.

careful.message: The production key was rotated by a party I know but am choosing not to name; asking me could produce the name.

ainglish.message: The production key was rotated by-withheld.
ainglish.reference: by-withheld means the author knows the doer and deliberately omitted the name; asking the author could produce it.

items.clarification: The author knows the actor and withheld the name. Ask the author to disclose it.

items.context: You must transfer referenced notice sha256:abc123 into a channel that supports exact Unicode text. Choose the compliant transformation plan.
items.source_intent: Every decoded Unicode code point of the referenced span must remain exact.

actions.description: Copy the referenced logical text code-point-for-code-point.
Reword every proposition while preserving its complete meaning.
Send a shorter lossy summary.

bare.message: Transfer notice sha256:abc123 faithfully.

careful.message: Transfer notice sha256:abc123 by reproducing its decoded Unicode text exactly, preserving every code point, space, line break and punctuation mark.

ainglish.message: Transfer the notice, text-fixed(sha256:abc123).
ainglish.reference: text-fixed(ref) requires the referenced logical text to be reproduced code-point-for-code-point, including case, punctuation, whitespace and normalization form.

items.clarification: The surface text is load-bearing. Copy the referenced logical text code-point-for-code-point.

items.context: You must transfer referenced notice sha256:def456 into a channel that cannot carry the source formatting but can carry a complete rewording. Choose the compliant plan.
items.source_intent: Surface wording may change, but complete meaning, scope, force, attribution and opaque literals must remain.

actions.description: Report that exact copying is unavailable and stop.
Reword every proposition while preserving its complete meaning and opaque literals.
Send a shorter lossy summary.

bare.message: Transfer notice sha256:def456 faithfully.

careful.message: Reword notice sha256:def456 as needed, but preserve its complete truth conditions, force, scope, attribution, references and every opaque literal; do not summarise it.

ainglish.message: Transfer the notice, meaning-fixed(sha256:def456).
ainglish.reference: meaning-fixed(ref) permits rewording but requires complete preservation of truth conditions, force, scope, attribution, references and opaque literals.

items.clarification: Exact formatting is not required. Produce a complete meaning-preserving paraphrase and preserve every opaque literal.

items.context: You route acknowledgements in a group channel containing Alex, Bo and Cy. Alex is the uniquely named receiving agent for this clause.
items.source_intent: Exactly Alex, not every member of the addressed group, must acknowledge.

actions.description: Collect one acknowledgement from Alex.
Collect acknowledgements from Alex, Bo and Cy.

bare.message: Alex: you must acknowledge the receipt.

careful.message: Alex alone is the one addressee required to acknowledge the receipt; the other group members are not addressed by this clause.

ainglish.message: Alex: you-one must acknowledge the receipt.
ainglish.reference: you-one denotes exactly one addressee who is uniquely recoverable from the communication context.

items.clarification: Only Alex is addressed by this clause. Collect Alex's acknowledgement.

items.context: You route acknowledgements in a group channel whose established addressed group is Alex, Bo and Cy.
items.source_intent: Every member of the three-person addressed group must acknowledge.

actions.description: Collect one acknowledgement from Alex.
Collect acknowledgements from Alex, Bo and Cy.

bare.message: You must acknowledge the receipt.

careful.message: Every member of the addressed group—Alex, Bo and Cy—must acknowledge the receipt.

ainglish.message: you-all must acknowledge the receipt.
ainglish.reference: you-all denotes every member of an explicitly established addressed group containing at least two members.

items.clarification: All three established addressees—Alex, Bo and Cy—must acknowledge.
